display_fil: Kaso: May sugat na namumula at may nana si Mara
display_en: Case: Mara has a red wound with pus
narration_fil: May sugat na namumula at may nana si Mara. Nais niyang gamitin ang pinakuluang dahon ng Bayabas.
narration_en: Mara has a red wound with pus. She wants to use boiled Bayabas leaves.

display_en:
Bayabas
Psidium guajava
Part: leafy tops
narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Psidium guajava. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay talbos/dahon; ang paksang gamit ay mga gamit sa balat na nakalista sa lumang manual. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Ipasuri agad ang lumalalang pamumula, nana, lagnat o ibang senyales ng impeksiyon.
narration_en: Find Psidium guajava on the reference card. The listed part is leafy tops; the use topic is skin uses listed in the legacy manual. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Seek prompt assessment for spreading redness, pus, fever or other infection concerns.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Bayabas ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Bayabas part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Bayabas.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Bayabas is unconfirmed.
Leafy tops of confirmed Psidium guajava.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_fil: Itinuro ng BHW ang Bayabas at botanical name sa card. Hindi niya pinaghulaang tama ang halamang nasa bakuran. Ipasuri agad ang lumalalang pamumula, nana, lagnat o ibang senyales ng impeksiyon.
narration_en: The BHW points to Bayabas and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Seek prompt assessment for spreading redness, pus, fever or other infection concerns.

narration_fil: Hindi kapalit ng pagsusuri at angkop na wound care ang herbal wash. Huwag subukan ang mainit na likido sa practice. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: A herbal wash does not replace assessment and appropriate wound care. Use no hot liquid in practice. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.
